meta.name: red-team
meta.description: Stress-test a plan, brief or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes. Use when the user asks for a red team or preparation for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对方案和交付结论做对抗式挑刺,提前揪出会翻车的地方
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在拍板前把重要方案的压力测试做扎实
copy.tagline_en: Pressure-test a plan or delivery claim against evidence before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes decision needs adversarial pressure-testing first

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会拿证据和可能的失败模式，对你的计划、简报或交付声明做压力测试，说明哪些地方站不住。它会先读任务上下文契约和红队方法文档，再据此给出检验结果。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个计划、简报或交付声明做红队测试，或要为一项重要决策做准备时触发。若由 @fde 调用，会沿用其现有的脱敏上下文包，不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我红队一下这份上线计划
say.note: 按证据和失败模式逐项检验

say.text: 对这个交付声明做红队，找出站不住的地方
我要做重要决策，先红队这份简报
say.note: 沿用当前上下文，不再重复提问

howto.what_en: Claude stress-tests a plan, brief, or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes. It reads the task context contract and the red-team method first, then reports where the material holds up and where it doesn't.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a red team, or when you prepare for a consequential decision. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.note: It checks the plan against evidence and failure modes.

say_en.text: Red-team this delivery claim and find where it fails.
I have a big decision - red-team this brief first.
say_en.note: Reuses the current context, no new questions.
